snippet.title: Jim & Dill 3 - Official NES Trailer | calgames
snippet.description:
Live The Story That Saved Rock & Roll!

A prequel to "Jim & Dill - The Legend of Weed N' Stiff", and "Jim & Dill 2 - Bobson's Revenge". Take control of Jim Weed and Dill Stiff in their origin story about the band that saved rock & roll forever.

Meet new and familiar characters as you form the band, make a demo tape, get a manager, and rise to fame over the universally-loathed band Moo Cow and singer Joe Bobson.

Arcade City is your home, and you seek the Legendary Studio... known for crafting rock stars. Joe Bobson has been searching for this studio his entire life.

Traverse the countryside and uncover the history of Joe Bobson and the Bobson family as you strive to find the path to rock & roll royalty.

A new game for the Nintendo Entertainment System. Available digitally as a ROM at calgmes.itch.io

Developed by calgames
Music by Jordan Davis and Dill Stiff
Based on the band Weed N' Stiff
